summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration work with Spark, including updates on Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features. Additionally, proposals for enhancements such as relative paths in the v4 spec and finer-grained read restrictions have been introduced.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on integration work
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on repartitioning old partition spec data files
Introduction of first-class Tag concept in Iceberg REST Catalog
